items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in public health or a related field (e.g., health science, nutrition, education, communication, sociology, social science, etc.) and/or the equivalent professional work experience / training.
Experience coordinating health-related programs, community outreach initiatives, research activities, program evaluation efforts, patient navigation services, or comparable projects.
Experience working with medically underserved or minority populations in a healthcare setting.

The UC Davis Comprehensive Cancer Center’s Office of Community Outreach and Engagement is seeking a mobile mammography program coordinator to expand access to breast cancer screening for underrepresented and medically underserved communities across the Greater Sacramento region. The incumbent will be responsible for providing programmatic, administrative and research implementation support, program evaluation, operational coordination, and patient navigation for the Mobile Mammo+ program. This includes serving as a liaison between the mobile mammography program and collaborating partners to plan; schedule and execute mammography screening days as well as any other future services the mobile clinic offers; manage data collection and reporting for program evaluation; and provide health system navigation and support.
Speaks, reads and writes Spanish or another language other than English.
Strong interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across diverse populations.
Knowledge of or ability to learn how to use REDCap database.

Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with all co-workers and other stakeholders engaged in the program; to consistently interact with patients and other members of the public with patience, courtesy and professionalism, both in-person and on the telephone; and to effectively respond to individuals who may be angry or upset.
Knowledge of or ability to learn and understand all pertinent laws, regulations, and guidelines governing medical records; confidentiality, privacy, and provision to others, including HIPAA.

Ability to efficiently use computer system applications for all functions required for this position, including electronic mail, spreadsheets, word processing, REDCap and medical office management, (i.e. scheduling, template maintenance, maintenance of demographic and insurance information).

Knowledge of or ability to learn about health care insurance systems, which may include Medi-Cal, MediCare, HMO, PPO, fee-for-service, county funded coverage, to support scheduling, follow up care coordination, and billing functions as needed.
Ability to learn and navigate the Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system (eg. EPIC).
Knowledge of proper body mechanics when transferring or assisting patients; ability to safely assist patients.
Ability to engage with individuals from diverse cultural and socioeconomic backgrounds effectively.
Ability to handle confidential information such as CD's and other medical documents.
Proven ability to manage multiple responsibilities, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines.
Ability to accomplish a variety of concurrent assignments in an effective and efficient manner, demonstrating ability to organize, prioritize and complete assignments in a designated time frame.
Ability to adjust to changing workload or assignments and pressures of increased workload or deadlines.

Problem solving skills to independently define a problem identify the resources available to help solve the problem, create viable solutions and take the necessary action to implement problem resolution and ensure prompt and satisfactory resolution.
Decision making skills to independently exercise delegated authority to take action and to appropriately seek assistance from others when limits of delegated authority have been reached.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on patient-centered care and team collaboration.
Ability to apply proper English grammar, spelling and punctuation, sufficient to compose messages and/or routine correspondence, which is clear, concise and easy to understand.
Ability to learn motivational interviewing techniques in order to address and resolve barriers to care effectively.
Typing skills sufficient to use computer keyboard for timely and accurate input and production.
